title: Value inspection
summary: Inventory, Info and a Reset button with nine captured Input structures.
task: Inspect and edit a stored structured value in Info without changing its source.
choose: you want to try Info's editing, copies and fresh fetches on known values.
prepares: nine labelled captures of Input's state shape in Inventory
Inventory, Info and the Demo controls

first_task.do: Drag `Demo input 1` from Inventory into Info, edit a scalar, then Save copy.
first_task.expect: Info shows the edited copy; Inventory gains a new entry and `Demo input 1` is unchanged.

variations: Fetch the original again in Info and compare
Press Reset demo and repeat with a fresh copy
limits: Info and Compose drafts are disposable here: Reset discards them

reset.scope: the layout, the nine Demo input entries' values and labels, Inventory's selection and the Info/Compose drafts on the desk
reset.keeps: every entry you created, including saved copies and commands; submitted commands are not undone
